## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Ruff passes.
- [ ] Tests pass and cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] English and Czech translations remain synchronized.
- [ ] No credentials, DSNs, tokens or raw device frames are included.
- [ ] User documentation and changelog are updated when applicable.
- [ ] Physical coffee-maker behavior was tested safely when applicable.

## Device evidence

List the exact model, Home Assistant version and safe verification performed, or
write `not applicable`.
